items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: you've probably heard of Art Hickman's band

ctx.x: And I made out a check to his wife whom I'd known at the same time. We were all more or less youngsters together, you see.

And she said, 'Art, I'm going to have a lot of trouble with Lou. Lulu, as we called him, 'Because he won't be satisfied, otherwise.' I said, 'You're going to have to keep your piano, I don't want it.'
